entry.title: NSTC funds orthognathic bad-split prediction project

link.title: NSTC funds orthognathic bad-split prediction project

entry.content: Taiwan’s National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) has funded our project on predicting unfavorable fractures (bad splits) in orthognathic surgery, with Dr. Huang as co-investigator.

entry.title: Public flap circulation demo released
entry.content: A second public demo classifies free-flap circulation from a photograph of the flap region, available on Hugging Face Spaces. An earlier version was retired after we found data leakage across patients; the current model is trained and evaluated with patient-level splits.

entry.title: Public burn segmentation demo released
entry.content: Our burn wound segmentation model is now available as a public demo on Hugging Face Spaces. Upload a photograph to see the wound outlined by the model. The demo is a research prototype and is not intended for clinical use.
